info.title: STUK.TradeAccountService.WebApi
info.description:
Demonstrates API endpoints for STUK.TradeAccountService.WebApi.

- 🌐 External (consumer-facing / session-based)
- 🔒 Internal (server-to-server / private)

get.summary: 🌐🔒 Get account details by account code.
get.description: Returns full account details including contacts, addresses, and payment profile for the given account code.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🌐 Search accounts linked to the authenticated user's session.
get.description: Returns paginated list of accounts for a user.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The number of page

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Allowed range 1-50

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🌐 Get credit limit details by account code.
get.description: Returns credit limit details for an account code.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🌐 Get high-level account details by account code.
get.description: Returns account, invoice, creditnote, statement, preferred branch and creditLimit details for an account code.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

parameters.name: recentInvoicesLimit
parameters.description: Number of recent invoices returned. Allowed range 1-10

parameters.name: recentCreditNotesLimit
parameters.description: Number of recent creditnotes returned. Allowed range 1-10

parameters.name: recentStatementsLimit
parameters.description: Number of recent statements returned. Allowed range 1-12

200.description: Account, invoice, creditnote, statement, preferred branch and creditLimit details for an account code retrived.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🔒 Validate account by account code, postcode, and brand. (Backward compatibility)
get.description: Returns account validation result including postcode and brand validity.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. allowed range 1-50

parameters.name: postCode
parameters.description: Unique post code is required, allowed range 1-10

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Unique brand code is required, allowed range 1-50

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🔒 Get credit limit by account code. (Backward compatibility)
get.description: Returns credit limit details for an account code.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

post.summary: Request a download token for a statement or transaction document.
post.description: Generates a time-limited download token for the given document. Set documentType to 'Statement' or 'Transaction' and provide the corresponding documentId.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: Download a document file using a token.
get.description: Returns the document file (statement or transaction) as a binary download. Token is obtained from the download-request endpoint and expires after a configured period.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: A token must be a GUID

PDF document.summary: The document is ready and returned as binary content (application/pdf).

File not ready.summary: The document is still being prepared for download.

value.message: The file is not ready for download yet. Please try again later.

File not found.summary: The download token has expired or the document does not exist.

value.message: The token has expired. Please create a new request for token.

PDF document.summary: The document is ready and returned as binary content (application/pdf).

File not ready.summary: The document is still being prepared for download.

value.message: The file is not ready for download yet. Please try again later.

File not found.summary: The download token has expired or the document does not exist.

value.message: The token has expired. Please create a new request for token.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🌐🔒 Get payment reference details by reference ID
get.description: Returns payment details including account, amount, and status for the given reference.

parameters.name: paymentReference
parameters.description: A paymentReference must be a GUID

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

post.summary: 🌐🔒 Create a payment reference for an account.
post.description: Creates a payment reference linking an account, branch, and payment amount.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

post.summary: 🔒 Create payment reference for SAPCC integration. (Backward compatibility)
post.description: Accepts SAPCC-format payment requests and creates one or more payment references.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🌐 Get preferred branch by account code.
get.description: Returns the preferred branch for an account code.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

put.summary: 🌐 Update preferred branch by account code.
put.description: Updates the preferred branch for the given account. BranchNumber is required in the request body.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

204.description: It means preferred branch has been updated

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

delete.summary: 🌐 Delete preferred branch by account code.
delete.description: Removes the preferred branch association for the given account.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

204.description: It means preferred branch has been removed

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of statements for an account code.

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

parameters.name: statementDateFrom
parameters.description: StatementDateFrom date must be before or equal to StatementDateTo

parameters.name: statementDateTo
parameters.description: A valid date for StatementDateTo

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The number of page

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Allowed range 1-50

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🌐🔒 Get transaction details by transaction id.
get.description: Returns full transaction details including metadata.

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: Transaction Id must be a Guid.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.summary: 🌐🔒 Search transactions by account code and document type.
get.description: Returns a paginated list of transactions. Document type: I (Invoice), C (Credit Note), A (Adjustment), P (Payment).

parameters.name: accountCode
parameters.description: Must contain at least one letter or number. Length of accountCode must be 1-25

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Allowed document types are 'I','C','A','P'. Invoice: I, CreditNote: C, Adjustments: A, Payemnts: P

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Comma separated value, no space in between. Invoice-> PAID, INQUERY, OVERDUE, DUE, NOT-DUE. Others-> USED, NOT-USED

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: It is compared with outstanding amount, customerReferenceNo and standard invoice no. Minimum length 3.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Allowed values are dueDate, issueDate, amount

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Allowed values are ASC, DESC

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The number of page

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Allowed range 1-50

404.description: The requested resource was not found.
